details: The US Senate has failed to pass the Clarity Act, a crucial piece of legislation intended to create a comprehensive regulatory framework for digital assets. The bill's rejection on September 15 leaves the cryptocurrency industry in the United States facing continued regulatory uncertainty.
title: US Senate Rejects Crypto Regulation Bill, Increases Uncertainty

details: Bitcoin is trading around $80,794, experiencing notable institutional demand with US Bitcoin ETFs attracting $433.03 million in net inflows on September 18. Despite these inflows, Bloomberg Intelligence warns of a "Catch-22" for crypto due to its high correlation with traditional stocks and macroeconomic factors like a strong dollar and rising bond yields, suggesting potential downside if equities fall.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $80K Amid ETF Inflows, Macro Correlation Concerns

details: The Federal Reserve recently hiked interest rates by 25 basis points on September 16, with the European Central Bank (ECB) also signaling a probable rate increase this month due to persistent inflation concerns. Higher interest rates generally increase borrowing costs and enhance the appeal of less-risky traditional assets, potentially reducing the attractiveness of speculative investments like cryptocurrencies.
title: Central Banks Maintain Tightening Stance Amid Persistent Inflation
